_comment: Bench fleet registry for tools/bench/identity_guard.py. Operator rules 2026-09-26: no test on a node without its own callsign (never XX0XXX), every callsign SSID unique, bench TX power at most 2 dBm, ESP32 nodes need WiFi, a set clock and the web server. No secrets in this file; WiFi credentials live in ~/MeshCom-bench-backups/. Hosts are the 2323 net-console addresses as of 2026-10-03 22:20 (identity_guard --info over USB): a node without a host (RAK = nRF52, T-Deck native USB reports its MAC as the serial number) is checked with --port. DK5EN-1 has its net console off by default (web /setparam/?netconsole=on) and its USB port is held by the soak capture.
